selection.reason: Implementation pilot; first two tasks selected before collecting their full results. Remaining manifest cases are not part of this pilot.

scope.interpretation: Exploratory implementation pilot. Two tasks were selected while the larger development run was in progress, before completing their cohorts. All selected trials are retained. No human preference ratings have been collected. The four holdout cases were not evaluated. Runs shared the machine with builds and measurements; elapsed times are descriptive, not a latency benchmark.
scope.foreground_scope: Explicit accompaniment generation/regeneration. Foreground selection is request-local; this pilot does not assess generic GUI regeneration of these clips.
